unknowns: Transitive lockfile integrity and installability require npm validation.

Environment inspection covers named development dotenv files, .env.example and simple Next config references only. Config matches are heuristic; arbitrary source, host variables and Docker environment wiring are not evaluated.

unresolved: Supply every template parameter without a default; select and confirm the deployment account and region separately.
Build and independently verify a production Linux X86_64 image in ECR. Development npm/runserver images are not production evidence.
Verify VPC/subnet membership, HTTPS listener protocol, certificate/DNS, ALB security group, unique hostname rule and unused rule priority.
Verify private-subnet egress (NAT or ECR/S3/logs/secret[REDACTED] endpoints), execution-role access and separate least-privilege task-role trust.
Review all runtime variables and Secret[REDACTED] Manager mappings. No dotenv values are copied; aws-runtime.json lists names only.
Verify the readiness route returns 200 with ALB health-check Host headers; authentication must remain intact.
Review availability, scaling, CPU/memory, outbound rules, log retention and budget before a separate deployment review.
Verify npm production build/start behavior, build-time NEXT_PUBLIC values, image contents and any writable cache or upload storage.

result.message: This action already has current evidence in the observations. Do not repeat it. Use those findings to choose a different necessary action, or finish with your answer if the task is complete.

action.reason: Generate AWS infrastructure artifacts (e.g., CloudFormation templates, IAM role definitions, CI/CD pipeline files) for this eligible Next.js app. The proposal will be presented to the user for review before any files are written. This step follows the requested workflow: show the proposal, ask for confirmation, then later validate the generated files locally. No deployment will be performed at this stage.

state.message:
The repository was inspected and is eligible as a Next.js app (Node 22, npm). A local‑only AWS preparation proposal already exists (observe the propose_aws result). It outlines the CloudFormation/ECS Fargate deployment, lists required parameters (VpcId, PrivateSubnetIds, AlbSecurityGroupId, HttpsListenerArn, Hostname, RulePriority, ImageUri, ExecutionRoleArn, TaskRoleArn, HealthPath) and the items still unresolved (parameter defaults, production image build, VPC/subnet validation, ALB health‑check routing, secret [REDACTED], runtime variables, scaling, budgeting, etc.).

To move forward, I can generate the local infrastructure files (e.g., CloudFormation template, aws‑runtime.json) based on this proposal. Please confirm you want those files created so they can be reviewed and later validated with apply_aws/validate_aws. If you need any adjustments or want to see the draft first, let me know.
